key.name: monitor-index
key.description: -1 for primary monitor, or 0, 1, 2 for specific display index.

key.name: dock-position
key.description: Edge of the monitor where the dock is anchored: right, left, top, or bottom.

key.name: dock-length-mode
key.description: 'fill' for full edge with struts, 'compact' for floating island dock.

key.name: dock-alignment
key.description: Alignment along the anchored edge when in floating island mode: center, start, or end.

key.name: dock-thickness
key.description: Width of vertical dock or height of horizontal dock (200 to 480px).

key.name: dock-margin
key.description: Margin distance in pixels from the screen edge.

key.name: dock-corner-radius
key.description: Border radius for dock container and cards in pixels.

key.name: dock-opacity
key.description: Background opacity for the dock container in percent (0 to 100).

key.name: card-opacity
key.description: Background opacity for telemetry cards in percent (0 to 100).

key.name: dock-affects-struts
key.description: Whether the dock reserves screen space so windows don't overlap it.

key.name: show-in-overview
key.description: Whether to keep the dock visible in GNOME overview.

key.name: scale-factor
key.description: Scale factor for the dials and text (0.75 - 1.5).

key.name: theme
key.description: Visual accent color scheme: cyan, white, amber, or green.

key.name: clock-style
key.description: Visual style for the clock: 'concentric', 'analog', or 'digital'.

key.name: temp-unit
key.description: 'c' for Celsius or 'f' for Fahrenheit.

key.name: update-interval
key.description: Polling rate for core metrics in seconds (1 to 10).

key.name: enable-interpolation
key.description: Smooth dial transitions using asymmetric attack and decay easing curves.

key.name: dock-edit-hotkey
key.description: Keybinding to enter in-situ dock customizer edit mode.

key.name: overlay-hotkey
key.description: Keybinding to show or hide the dock.

key.name: dock-modules
key.description: Array of module identifiers determining the visual stacking sequence in the dock.

key.name: show-clock
key.description: Enable or disable the clock and date dial.

key.name: show-cpu
key.description: Enable or disable the CPU package and multi-core dials.

key.name: show-memory
key.description: Enable or disable the RAM utilization dial.

key.name: show-disk
key.description: Enable or disable the Disk space dial.

key.name: show-network
key.description: Enable or disable the Network I/O speed dials.

key.name: show-processes
key.description: Enable the expandable top processes tray.

key.name: show-connections
key.description: Enable the expandable active sockets tray.

key.name: topbar-show-pill
key.description: Show glanceable telemetry micro-badges in GNOME top panel.

key.name: topbar-metrics
key.description: List of metrics to show in top bar: 'ram', 'cpu', 'temp', 'net'.

key.name: topbar-alert-threshold
key.description: Percent utilization at which top bar badges shift to alert color.
